name: flame.knowledgebase/delete.v1
description: Delete a document and its index at the inspected revision.

name: flame.knowledgebase/import.v1
description: Import or replace a user document and its embedding index at the inspected revision; use zero for a new document.

name: flame.knowledgebase/list.v1
description: List indexed user documents and their revisions.

name: flame.knowledgebase/read.v1
description: Read one complete stored document with its exact source, revision and index identity without embedding or provider I/O.

name: flame.knowledgebase/reindex.v1
description: Rebuild an existing document's embedding index from its stored original text at the inspected revision through the configured embedding role.

name: flame.knowledgebase/search.v1
description: Retrieve cited chunks from indexed user documents through the configured embedding role.
